description: This Council has been asked for its observations on an application received by Westminster City Council for Variation of conditions 4, 7,16, 23, 31, 39, 40, 41, 42, 43 of planning permission dated 23rd July 2024 (RN:23/07119/FULL) for the Variation of Condition 1 (approved plans) of planning permission dated 11 May 2022 (RN:18-09727-FULL) as amended by two non-material amendments (23/04588/NMA & 23/06258/NMA) for Demolition of existing buildings at Nos 28-34 Queensway and Olympia Mews and redevelopment of site by erection of a six storey, plus basement level, building comprising Class E retail floor space and residential flats (Class C3) and erection of a replacement two storey building for use as Class E office floorspace, together with associated landscaping. NAMELY, Introduction of greater flexibility of use of the Olympia Mews building: Variation of condition 16 to become a compliance condition in relation to noise assessment; variation of condition 23 (parts B and C) to become a compliance condition in relation to conservation method statement; Variation of conditions 31, 41, 42, 43, with submission of relevant information to amend this to become a compliance condition, in relation to all planting and soft andscaping across the scheme; Variation of conditions 39 and 40, with submission of relevant information to amend this to become a compliance condition, in relation to tree protection and arboricultural monitoring; Design changes to three apartments, the communal garden area, and landscaping strategy. and changes to vehicle access areas in Consort Mews to remove the requirements for two-way access along the entire length of the carriageway. RECONSULTATION TO INCLUDE CHANGES TOCONSORTMEWS)
site_name: Development site at Olympia Mews and 28 - 34 Queensway, LONDON
